bibliographic.title: Odieus's Quest for the Magic Flingshot
bibliographic.author: Anonymous
bibliographic.description:
Your name is Odieus and you come from a long line of sorcerers and enchantresses. You're well-educated in the art of spell flinging, but unfortunately your magic flingshot has been stolen by your arch-enemy, Blackwing, son of Blackfeather. Your mission is to enter Blackwing's lair and recover your prized possession.

This game was originally written by an unknown author using LADS and published on CompuServe circa 1988.

The LADS version was ported to AGT and embellished by David Malmberg in 1990. This made it available to any computer with an AGT interpreter. Versions are known for the Atari ST and MS-DOS.

The AGT version was ported to the Atari 400/800 by John E using AdventureWriter in December 1993 and published in The Grim Reaper, issue 13, July 1994.

Finally, the AGT version was ported to Inform by Teo Kwang Liak in October 1994. However, this version is a beta version and is reported to be buggy.
